I am a behavioural scientist interested in judgment and decision-making, risk perception, and climate change. My research examines how people understand and respond to complex information, especially in contexts involving uncertainty, environmental risk, and public policy.

My work combines behavioural experiments, large-scale surveys, longitudinal data, and statistical modelling to study how people form beliefs, make decisions, and respond to risk.
